summary:
Comprehensive UX simplification plan for TailGuard:
1. Re-architect Dashboard screen using progressive disclosure (compact glance card with expandable granular inspector for Gateway, DNS, Subnet, RSSI).
2. Consolidate secondary controls (safeguards, RSSI sliders, broadcast testing, system VPN shortcut) into a single Collapsible Advanced Controls section.
3. Streamline Hero card with embedded live connection summary pills.
4. Maintain 100% of existing network insight, diagnostic hooks, and automated rules.
